children: Boohoo Group's fiscal first-half update left investors relatively unmoved, AJ Bell's Russ Mould writes in a note. "After some decent gains in recent months, the market will be keen to see further evidence it is delivering on the recovery plan," Mould says. Nonetheless, the U.K. clothing retailer has improved its balance sheet as it focuses on cash generation. Shares in Boohoo Group, which trades as Debenhams, are up 2% at 25 pence. ( najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
